title: Sonos Black Friday Sale Takes Up to 25% Off Speakers, Soundbars, and More
content:
Sonos is back with its annual Black Friday sale, with up to 25 percent off select products through November 30. This event includes savings on speakers, soundbars, headphones, subwoofers, and many more of the best Sonos audio accessories.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with Sonos. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Highlights from this event include the Sonos Ace for $229, a $120 discount on the headphones. There are also quite a few soundbars on sale, ranging from the cheaper Ray for $169 ($50 off) to the high-end Arc Ultra for $849 ($250 off).
